## What this page will contain

A single table mapping "your situation" (`stat_goal` x `design`, using the
same controlled vocabulary as the prompt-library schema in
`prompts/_schema.yaml`) to the matching chapter in one of the seven verified
external textbooks, each row tagged with its license:

| Textbook | License |
|---|---|
| psyteachr data-skills | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| psyteachr analysis | CC BY 4.0 |
| psyteachr stat-models | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| psyteachr quant-fun | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| psyteachr reprores | CC BY |
| lsj-book (Foxcroft / Navarro) | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| bradduthie/stats | CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (link only, no excerpting) |

This page is English-only (the source textbooks are all in English) and its
table is meant to be generated from the `links` field of each prompt-library
entry (`prompts/entries/*.yaml`), so the mapping is maintained in one place.
That generation step is out of scope for Phase 0; this page is a scaffold
placeholder only.
